title: Reading a CSV file
description:
Write a CSV file and read it back into structs.

```
wrote 3 rows to scores.csv
Ada,91
Bob,48
Cy,77
average 72.00, best Ada
```
hints: `sscanf(line, "%31[^,],%d", r.name, &r.score) == 2` reads a name up to the comma and the number after it (lesson 5.03).
`fprintf(stderr, "skipping: %s", line)` keeps warnings apart from the normal output.
requirements: Write the file with `fopen(..., "w")` and `fprintf`; read it with `fgets` and `sscanf`.
Check `fopen`'s result and close every file.
A line that does not parse is skipped with a warning on `stderr`.
stretch: Add a header line (`name,score`) and skip it.
